title: Adira Tyree
text: Every time Adira attacks or is attacked and is not neutralized, she gains +1 Intrigue.

title: Centauri Agent
text: Multiple.

title: Centauri Aide
text: Multiple.

title: Centauri Captain
text: Multiple.

title: Centauri Telepath
text: Rotate Centauri Telepath to look at 3 random cards from one player's hand. You may place one of these cards on top of his deck.

title: Emperor Turhan
text: Centauri Emperor. Emperor Turhan cannot become an Inner Circle character. Rotate to alter any Centauri tension by 1.

title: Lady Ladira
text: Lady Ladira is a seer and prophetess. When she arrives on Babylon 5, she is struck by a compelling vision â€” the station's future destruction. She warns that this future may be avoided, but cannot say how.

title: Lord Kiro
text: Rotate and discard Lord Kiro to go through your deck, find The Eye, and play it on your ambassador for no cost, then shuffle your deck.

title: Lord Refa
text: Centauri unrest grows by 1 when Lord Refa is sponsored.

title: Lord Valo
text: Rotate Lord Valo and any other character you control to remove one mark from that character.

title: Londo Mollari
text: Centauri Starting Ambassador. If Londo gains a weapon enhancement, he gains a Strife Mark.

title: Lyndisty
text: Rotate Lyndisty to increase the damage on any Narn character who has been damaged but not neutralized this turn by 3.

title: Minister Malachi
text: Rotate Minister Malachi to draw a card.

title: Bester
text: You must draw 2 free cards (instead of 1) per turn while you control Bester. Bester cannot become an Inner Circle character.

title: Frederick Lantz
text: If there are any conflicts in play which can raise tension that Frederick Lantz can oppose, Frederick Lantz must oppose one. You cannot pass until he has done so.

title: General Franklin
text: General Franklin gains +5 Leadership while leading a fleet that is supporting a Military conflict that targets a location.

title: General Hague
text: Rotate General Hague as an action to add a construction token to this card. Each time you sponsor a fleet, remove all construction tokens from General Hague. Each token removed reduces the cost for you to sponsor that fleet by 2 (to a minimum cost of 0).

title: Jeffrey Sinclair
text: Rotate Jeffrey Sinclair to prevent the Minbari tension toward the Humans from increasing for the rest of the turn.

title: Luis Santiago
text: Earth Alliance President. Luis Santiago cannot become an Inner Circle character. Rotate Luis Santiago to move any altered Human tension or unrest to the level at which it began the turn.

title: Sandra Hiroshi
text: Events played by you that target Sandra Hiroshi are played at -3 influence cost (minimum cost 0).

title: Sarah
text: Sarah cannot attack. The cost for the Human player to sponsor Sarah is reduced by an amount equal to Human unrest.

title: Senator Voudreau
text: Earth Alliance Senator. Elise Voudreau is an Earth Alliance Senator. She has a particular interest in activities on Babylon 5 that may be linked to the rebellion on Mars colony. She believes that "Practicality is more important than principles."

title: Warren Keffer
text: Any fleet Warren Keffer is leading suffers 1 less damage than normal during each attack.

title: Zack Allan
text: Zack Allan gains +1 Intrigue for each Inner Circle character you control who is Human.

title: Delenn
text: Minbari Starting Ambassador. Grey Council Member. Religious Caste.

title: Delenn Transformed
text: Religious Caste. You may sponsor characters from other races at -2 cost. The Chrysalis event is required to bring Delenn Transformed into play.

title: Dhaliri
text: Grey Council Member. Religious Caste. When Dhaliri is neutralized, he suffers 1 additional point of severe damage.

title: Durlan
text: Grey Council Member. Worker Caste. Rotate to give a character +1 Leadership for the rest of the turn.

title: Lovell
text: Religious Caste. Rotate Lovell to attack a Human character using Lovell's Intrigue. Discard Lovell when he makes this attack.

title: Minbari Agent
text: Worker Caste. Multiple.

title: Minbari Aide
text: Religious Caste. Multiple.

title: Minbari Captain
text: Warrior Caste. Multiple.

title: Neroon
text: You may choose to play aftermath cards which target your ambassador on Neroon instead. If this is done, anytime the card refers to your ambassador, it affects Neroon instead.

title: Rathenn
text: Grey Council Member. Religious Caste. Rotate to alter the Minbari tension toward any race by 1.

title: Shakat
text: Grey Council Member. Warrior Caste. For each point of damage Shakat heals you must apply 1 influence.

title: Shal Mayan
text: Rotate Shal and apply 5 influence to ready a rotated Inner Circle character. The effect of that character's action is not cancelled. If the character participated in a conflict, he cannot participate in that same conflict.

title: Warleader Shakiri
text: Warleader Shakiri gains +1 Leadership while leading the Warleader's Fleet.

title: Du'Nar
text: Member of the Kha'Ri. If Du'Nar is injured but not neutralized, remove 1 damage token from him during each ready round.

title: Du'Rog
text: If Du'Rog is discarded from play, you may cause 4 points of damage to any Narn character.

title: G'Drog
text: Any ready fleet led by G'Drog can take damage in place of any other Narn fleet being attacked. G'Drog's fleet is then rotated.

title: G'Kar
text: Starting Narn Ambassador. Member of the Kha'Ri. G'Kar gains +2 Intrigue while he is the target of an Intrigue conflict.

title: G'Sten
text: While ready, you may cause a Narn fleet that is attacked to suffer only half damage. If this effect is applied, rotate G'Sten.

title: Ja'Doc
text: While ready, you may negate any event being played. Discard Ja'Doc when this effect is used.

title: Kha'Mak
text: Narn Character. Representative of the Kha'Ri. Cannot become an Inner Circle character. Rotate to reduce the cost of the next Narn character you sponsor this turn by 2. Your influence rating is increased by +1 while you control Kha'Mak.

title: Na'Far
text: While ready, you may cause any Narn character who is attacked to suffer 3 less damage. Rotate Na'Far when this effect is used.

title: Na'Toth
text: Narn Ambassador's Assistant. Na'Toth may replace Ko'Dath.

title: Narn Agent
text: Multiple.

title: Narn Aide
text: Multiple.

title: Narn Captain
text: Having survived a century of Centauri occupation, the Narn military have become fierce and aggressive warriors. Expect a Narn captain to be extremely loyal to his people, and to be willing to sacrifice himself and his ship to protect Narn civilians.

title: Tu'Pari
text: Rotate Tu'Pari and apply 8 influence to attack any character using whichever of the target's abilities is highest (target's choice if there is a tie). Any character in the target character's faction may attack Tu'Pari in return.

title: Catherine Sakai
text: Rotate Catherine Sakai and apply 5 influence. Go through your deck until you find the first location. Put the location in your hand and shuffle your deck.

title: Cynthia Torqueman
text: Rotate Cynthia Torqueman to support or oppose any number of conflicts at the same time. You decide whether she supports or opposes each conflict.

title: Dan Randall
text: Media Character. Rotate Dan Randall and apply 3 influence to force another player to apply 4 influence (for no effect).

title: Disaffected Centauri
text: Multiple. Each player may only have 1 Disaffected Centauri in play. While Disaffected Centauri is a member of your Inner Circle, you may sponsor Centauri characters at normal (instead of double) influence cost. If you use this ability, you cannot apply any other cost reduction.

title: Disaffected Human
text: Multiple. Each player may only have 1 Disaffected Human in play. While Disaffected Human is a member of your Inner Circle, you may sponsor Human characters at normal (instead of double) influence cost. If you use this ability, you cannot apply any other cost reduction.

title: Disaffected Minbari
text: Multiple. Each player may only have 1 Disaffected Minbari in play. While Disaffected Minbari is a member of your Inner Circle, you may sponsor Minbari characters at normal (instead of double) influence cost. If you use this ability, you cannot apply any other cost reduction.

title: Disaffected Narn
text: Multiple. Each player may only have 1 Disaffected Narn in play. While Disaffected Narn is a member of your Inner Circle, you may sponsor Narn characters at normal (instead of double) influence cost. If you use this ability, you cannot apply any other cost reduction.

title: Elric
text: Techno-mage. Treat Elric as a Seeress. Discard Elric if the Shadow War has started. Discard Elric if you have any Shadow Marks or Vorlon Marks.

title: Marcus Cole
text: Ranger. The Human and Minbari players may sponsor Marcus Cole as if he had a 7 cost. While you control Marcus Cole, the cost for you to sponsor any Ranger group is reduced by 2.

title: Mary Ann Cramer
text: Media Character. Rotate to move one tension rating of any player by 1.

title: Morden
text: Requires 3 Shadow Marks to sponsor. Morden gains +1 Intrigue for each Shadow Mark he has. Rotate Morden to reduce the cost of any card providing or requiring Shadow Marks by the number of Shadow Marks he has (minimum cost 0).

title: Mr. Adams
text: Rotate Mr. Adams to give one character you control +2 to any ability, if that character is participating in a conflict that can increase one player's influence while reducing another player's influence.

title: Rogue Soul Hunter
text: Soul Hunter. Cannot be sponsored by the Minbari faction. Rotate to cause the top character in another player's discard pile to become a supporting character for you for the rest of the turn. At the end of the turn, return him to the same discard pile. If the character is Limited, no other copy of that character may be in play.

title: Soul Hunter
text: **Soul Hunter.** Cannot be sponsored by the Minbari faction. Rotate to cause the top character in another player's discard pile to become a supporting character for you for the rest of the turn. At the end of the turn, return him to the same discard pile. If the character is Limited, no other copy of that character may be in play.

title: Kosh Naranek
text: Vorlon Character. Once played, Kosh Naranek is treated as a Group instead of a Character. For every 3 influence any player applies to Kosh Naranek, his ambassador gains 1 Vorlon Mark for the rest of the turn.

title: Colonial Fleet (Centauri)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you unless you are at war.

title: First Battle Fleet (Centauri)
text: Like most warships of its size, Centauri battle cruisers are capable of opening their own jump points. Smaller fighters and transports must either rely on a jump gate or enter the jump point created by a larger ship.

title: Garrison Fleet
text: Multiple. Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: Picket Fleet (Centauri)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: Second Battle Fleet (Centauri)
text: The fleet position of Grand Fleet Admiral is an ancestral position of great honor, with a life of training from birth in the noble house Dromo.

title: Third Battle Fleet (Centauri)
text: The Third Battle Fleet cannot be the first fleet to support or oppose any conflict.

title: Utility Fleet (Centauri)
text: The Centauri fleet is powerful, but on its own is incapable of requiring neighbouring powers. They will require an alliance to move against their enemies.

title: Colonial Fleet (Human)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you unless you are at war.

title: Deep Space Fleet (Human)
text: It takes 4 jumps to get to Babylon 5 from Earth. Fast fleets can make it in three jumps by using a shortcut through Sirius.

title: First Battle Fleet (Human)
text: Multiple.

title: Fleet of the Line
text: This fleet gains +4 Military while participating in a Military conflict that targets you.

title: Picket Fleet (Human)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: Reserve Fleet
text: You may only sponsor this fleet if you have a tension of 5 toward another race.

title: Second Battle Fleet (Human)
text: EarthForce ships not only patrol to keep the peace, but also engage in deep space exploration. The ships have to be heavily supplied as they may not return to known space for years.

title: Colonial Fleet (Minbari)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: First Battle Fleet (Minbari)
text: Minbari warships have "stealth" technology that prevents enemy weapon scanners from getting a lock. During the Earth-Minbari War, this made it virtually impossible for EarthForce fighters to destroy Minbari assault vessels.

title: Grey Council Fleet
text: You may only initiate Military conflicts that target a player with whom you are at war. This fleet may be promoted to your Inner Circle. If this fleet is then neutralized, it heals as an Inner Circle character until unneutralized and is not discarded. (The fleet is not otherwise treated as an Inner Circle character.)

title: Picket Fleet (Minbari)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: Second Battle Fleet (Minbari)
text: Because no other race has military technology superior to the Minbari, other means must be used to achieve victory. John Sheridan destroyed the cruiser Black Star by seeding an asteroid belt with mines that he could set off by remote control.

title: Third Battle Fleet (Minbari)
text: The Minbari fleet has the most advanced military technology of any major star power (except for highly evolved races like the Vorlons and Shadows). In a straight-up fight, no other race possesses the technology to defeat them.

title: Warleader's Fleet
text: None of your Minbari fleets except the Warleader's Fleet or the Grey Council Fleet may participate in any conflict while the Warleader's Fleet is ready.

title: Colonial Fleet (Narn)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you unless you are at war.

title: First Battle Fleet (Narn)
text: The Narn heavy dreadnought is a Mak'Aroon class cruiser. It has two 500-gigawatt G'nath laser cannons. Its maximum linear thrust is 109 Megachoths.

title: Heavy Fleet
text: Narn forces have been improved considerably in recent years. After their liberation from Centauri occupation, the Narn began building a vast military capable of defending them from another invasion. That force is now being used offensively as well.

title: Picket Fleet (Narn)
text: Can only participate in conflicts targeting you.

title: Second Battle Fleet (Narn)
text: Narn warships fight battles in tandem with support fighters. The fighters, however, do not have the ability to create their own jump points, so they must enter or exit hyperspace through a jump point created by cruisers.

title: Strike Fleet
text: Nam warships are formidable opponents. They are roughly equal in technology to the Humans and Centauri, and certainly superior to lesser powers such as the Drazi, the Pak'ma'ra, or the Brakiri.

title: Drazi Sunhawk
text: Any player may sponsor this fleet at double normal influence cost. If Drazi Sunhawk becomes damaged, discard it during the next draw round.

title: Ipsha Battleglobe
text: Any player may sponsor this fleet. Apply 2 influence when you rotate Ipsha Battleglobe. The first player each turn to apply 2 influence to the Ipsha Battleglobe takes control of the fleet. A player may apply this cost even if he already controls the fleet.

title: Markab Fleet
text: Any player may sponsor this fleet at double normal influence cost. This fleet ignores 2 points of damage from each attack.

title: Vree Saucers
text: Any player may sponsor this fleet at double normal influence cost. While ready, any fleet that attacks one of your fleets suffers 1 point of damage after the attack is resolved.

title: A Rising Power
text: Rotate this agenda to provide +5 support to any Diplomacy conflict that will give you influence. Count each 10 Diplomacy you have from ready characters you control as +1 power.

title: As It Was Meant To Be
text: If the top card on your discard pile is a character, enhancement, group or fleet you may purge a Destiny Mark as an action to put that card into your hand. Your ambassador gains a Destiny Mark each time you initiate and win a conflict. Count each character you control with a Destiny Mark as 1 power.

title: Defense in Depth
text: All of your fleets gain +2 Military while you are the target of a Military conflict. All of your locations gain +5 Military. Your influence rating is increased by 1 for each location of your race you control.

title: Finish the War
text: Once per turn you may lose 1 influence to raise your tension toward the Humans by 1. If your tension toward the Humans is at 5, you may declare war conflicts against human factions and they may declare war conflicts against you.

title: Forced Evolution
text: Requires 5 Shadow Marks. Count the Shadow's influence minus the Vorlon's influence as power. You may transfer 1 influence per turn to the Shadows. Rotate agenda and apply target fleet's influence cost to neutralize 1 fleet with Military less than Shadow influence; purge 1 Shadow Mark from your faction.

title: Growth in Chaos
text: Your ambassador gains a Shadow Mark. The cost for you to play cards requiring Shadow Marks is reduced by 1 for each Shadow Mark you have. You may rotate this agenda to give a character +1 Leadership per Shadow Mark you have. Count each 2 Shadow Marks you have as 1 power.

title: Higher Calling
text: Count each 2 Destiny Marks your characters have as 1 power. Your ambassador gains +4 to each of his abilities while participating in any conflict which can result in your faction gaining a Destiny Mark. Shadow Marks and Vorlon Marks on all characters for all factions count double.

title: Imperialism
text: Your ambassador gains +2 Leadership. Gain +2 influence for each location you capture. Lose 2 influence if a location you control is captured. You may use captured locations as if they were your own.

title: Infiltrate and Exploit
text: Apply 5 influence to initiate an Intrigue conflict. Choose one of the following goals, which will occur if successful: Gain +1 influence; Your target loses 1 influence. Choose a target ability, your ambassador will gain a permanent bonus (which can accumulate) of +1 to that ability.

title: Knowledge is Power
text: Your ambassador gains +2 Intrigue. Apply 7 influence to initiate an Intrigue conflict. If you win by 5 or more, your target must either discard an Inner Circle character, or you gain +1 influence and your target loses 1 influence.

title: Leading the Races
text: For each Destiny Mark your ambassador has, the cost for you to sponsor any character is reduced by 1. Count each racial type (including Neutral characters and Non-Aligned) represented by a character in your Inner Circle as 1 power.

title: Maintain the Peace
text: You must have at least 20 Military in ready fleets to sponsor this agenda. Rotate as an action to initiate a Military conflict targeting one other Military conflict. If, at the beginning of resolution, this conflict has more support than its target conflict, neither conflict resolves. Each turn no Military conflict resolves, place a peace token on this agenda. Whenever a Military conflict resolves, remove all peace tokens. Count each peace token as 1 power.

title: Meddling with Others
text: Your ambassador gains a Doom Mark. Apply 5 influence to initiate one conflict against a target race: Intrigue: If successful, the target's unrest increases by 1. Diplomacy: If successful, factions of the target race lose 1 influence. Military: If successful, the cost for all players to sponsor fleets of that race increases by 1.

title: Order Above All
text: Requires 5 Vorlon Marks. Count the Vorlon's influence minus the Shadow's influence as power. You may transfer 1 influence per turn to the Vorlons. Rotate and purge 1 Vorlon Mark from your faction to cancel one war conflict or one conflict card. Any combination of players may apply influence equal to Vorlon Influence to negate this effect.

title: Peace In Our Time
text: Count every 3 points of Babylon 5 influence as 1 power. Target a race. You may apply 10 influence plus 1 per fleet of that race in play to lower that race's tension toward one other race by 1.

title: Seizing Advantage
text: Pay 5 influence (in addition to other conflict requirements) to play a conflict card from another player's discard pile (as if it were from your hand). Each time your faction neutralizes a character with an attack and the character is discarded that same turn, your neutralizing character gains a Doom Mark and your faction (permanently) gains +1 power.

title: Servants of Order
text: Your ambassador gains a Vorlon Mark. Purge a Vorlon Mark to go through your deck until you find the first card requiring or picturing Vorlon Marks. Place that card in your hand, then shuffle your deck. Count each 2 Vorlon Marks you have as 1 power.

title: Strength in Adversity
text: Rotate this agenda to apply support or opposition to any conflict. The amount applied is equal to the difference between the highest player influence rating minus your influence rating. If the player with the most power has 1 to 4 more power than you do, count the difference as power.

title: Support of the Mighty
text: Your cost to sponsor any character with an ability of 6 or higher is reduced by 2. Count each of your ready characters with an ability of 6 or more as 1 power.

title: The Hope of Peace
text: Each character you control gains +1 Diplomacy. Count every 4 points of Babylon 5's influence as 1 power.

title: Total War
text: Your ambassador loses 2 Diplomacy and gains a Doom Mark, but gains +2 Leadership while you are at war. If a war conflict you initiate is contested but successful, you gain +1 influence and your target loses 1 influence. While opposing your conflicts or attacking your fleets, all other players' fleets gain +1 Military.

title: A Brighter Future
text: If this conflict succeeds by 10 or more, this card becomes a Babylon 5 enhancement. While it is in play, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence each turn there is no war. If the conflict succeeds by 20 or more, Babylon 5 gains an additional +1 influence each turn no one initiates a military conflict.

title: Affirmation of Power
text: If successful, you and Babylon 5 each gain 1 influence. If the conflict succeeds by 10 or more, you and Babylon 5 each gain an additional influence. If the conflict fails, you and Babylon 5 each lose 1 influence.

title: Alliance
text: Target another race with whom you have a mutual tension of 1 and no Alliance. If successful, there is a state of Alliance between your two races. You each gain +1 influence for each 5 influence your ally has. If your two races ever go to war, the state of Alliance ends and you each lose 1 influence for each 5 influence your ally has.

title: Attacking Pawns
text: Your ambassador gains a Doom Mark. Target another player's supporting character. If you succeed by 5 or more, discard the target character. If you succeed by 10 or more, gain +1 influence.

title: Bio-Weapon Discovery
text: Target one fleet you control. If you win by 5 or more, this conflict becomes a fleet enhancement for that fleet. During each ready round, place a bio-weapon token on the fleet. The target fleet gains +1 Military for each bio-weapon token to a maximum of +5. If you lose by 5 or more, discard one supporting or non-ambassador Inner Circle character.

title: Black Market
text: Your ambassador gains a Doom Mark. If successful, this card becomes a faction enhancement which reduces the cost for you to play or sponsor any card by 1 for each Inner Circle character you rotate when playing the card (including the sponsor).

title: Blockade
text: Target one race with whom you have a tension of 4 or 5. If successful, reduce the influence rating of all factions of the target race to the level at which they began the turn (to a minimum of 10). Those factions cannot gain any more influence this turn, and this conflict is returned to your hand.

title: Border Raid
text: Target another faction. Only the following cards can participate in this conflict: One fleet from you and your target, and leaders for those fleets. If this conflict is uncontested, the target loses 1 influence. If you win by 5 or more, gain +1 influence. Tensions between your two races increase by 1.

title: Campaign for Support
text: Any player may be supported in this conflict. Whichever player generates the highest total gains an influence bonus on the next turn equal to the amount by which he exceeded the next highest total. This influence may only be applied to sponsor a new character, and it does not count as power.

title: Compatible Goals
text: If this conflict succeeds by 5 or more, this card becomes an aftermath targeting your ambassador. Your ambassador may sponsor characters from any race whose ambassador is not in play at 2 less influence cost.

title: Complete Support
text: Each character of your race gains +1 Diplomacy while this conflict is being resolved. If this conflict succeeds by at least five times your unrest, alter one of your tensions to any level you desire.

title: Condemn Deportations
text: Target another race. If this conflict is successful, the tensions of all races toward the target race increase by 1. If any race was already at 5 tension toward the target race when this tension increase occurred, each faction of the target race loses 1 influence.

title: Consolidated Position
text: Only members of your race may participate in this conflict. If the conflict is uncontested and support exceeds at least your unrest times 5, this card becomes an aftermath targeting your ambassador. While in effect, no other player may play aftermath cards targeting your ambassador.

title: Court the Rebellious
text: If you win the conflict by 5 or more, this conflict becomes a faction enhancement for you which, when you sponsor a character loyal to a race besides your own, reduces the character's cost by his race's unrest.

title: Crusade
text: If successful, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence and this conflict is returned to your hand.

title: Demonstrative Victory
text: Any player may be supported in this conflict. Any player who generates a total of 10 or more below the highest generated total may not gain more than 1 influence per turn for the rest of the game. If any player suffers this effect, the conflict becomes a global aftermath affecting their factions. This effect is negated for any player if his homeworld is in play.

title: Establish Base
text: If any fleet attacks occur during this conflict, Babylon 5 loses 2 influence. If successful, this conflict becomes a faction enhancement for you. While in play, your fleets gain +1 Military, and gain an additional +1 Military while you are the target of a Military conflict.

title: Extreme Sanction
text: Your ambassador gains a Doom Mark. Target a supporting character of another faction. If successful, apply influence equal to the target character's cost. Remove the character from play. (If limited, no copy of that character can reenter play).

title: Gunboat Diplomacy
text: Target another race. If successful, players of that race lose 1 influence, and you gain +1 influence if you win by 5-9, or +2 influence if you win by 10 or more. If unsuccessful, exchange recipients of these effects. If one or more fleet attacks occur, Babylon 5 loses 1 influence and all players' tensions grow by 1 toward the race of the fleet that first attacked.

title: Hate Crime
text: Target another player's supporting character. For each 5 strength by which this conflict succeeds, Babylon 5 loses 1 influence. If you succeed by 10 or more, discard target supporting character.

title: Humanitarian Aid
text: Target a race that was the target of a won war conflict last turn. If successful, Babylon 5 gains +2 influence, and each faction of the target race gains +1 influence.

title: Hunter, Prey
text: If successful, this card becomes a faction enhancement which you can rotate to apply 2 Intrigue support or opposition to any Intrigue conflict.

title: Loss of Support
text: Target a player who has an unrest of 3 or more. If successful, the target must discard one group of your choice.

title: Muddy the Waters
text: If successful, this card becomes a faction enhancement for you. While in play, at the end of each conflict round, you may exchange the conflict card you played (if any) with one from your hand.

title: Na'Ka'Leen Feeder
text: Any player may be supported in this conflict. Whichever player generates the lowest total must return one supporting character to his hand, or demote an Inner Circle character to a supporting character. If there is a tie for the lowest total, all tied players must do so.

title: Neutrality Treaty
text: Target another race with whom you have no state of Neutrality. Characters of your two races apply double diplomacy during resolution. If successful, there is a state of Neutrality between your two races. Characters and fleets of your races cannot attack each other. Any player of your two races may cancel the state of Neutrality during any draw round.

title: Non-Aggression Pact
text: Target 2 races with mutual tensions of 2 or less not in a state of Non-Aggression. If successful, there is a state of Non-Aggression between the two races, and Babylon 5 gains +1 influence. Factions of the two races cannot target each other with Military conflicts, and fleets of the two races cannot attack each other. The Non-Aggression state ends if either race's tension toward the other is at 4 or more.

title: Non-Aligned Support
text: There must be no Non-Aligned player and you must have a Destiny Mark to initiate this conflict. If successful, end the effect of any previous Non-Aligned Support conflict, and the League of Non-Aligned Worlds will vote as you dictate for any Babylon 5 vote if the result of the vote is a tie.

title: Parliament of Dreams
text: If successful, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence. For each 10 points by which this conflict succeeds, characters and fleets cannot attack for one turn.

title: Peacekeeping
text: Target two players at war. Add half of Babylon 5's influence as support to this conflict (round up). If you succeed, the war ends and both participants lose 2 influence. If you fail, you and Babylon 5 each lose 2 influence.

title: Precision Strike
text: Requires 3 Shadow Marks to play. Target one player. If successful, look at one player's hand and, for each 5 points by which this conflict succeeded, discard one card of your choice.

title: Psi Attack
text: Target another player's non-ambassador character. The first character you rotate to support this conflict must have a Psi rating of 5 or higher. If successful, the target character is rotated if ready. You may sustain with your initial character. If you do so, the target cannot ready while you sustain.

title: Psi Interrogation
text: If you do not support with at least one character with Psi above 0, this conflict fails. Psi may be used as Intrigue in this conflict. If successful, reveal all hidden agendas besides your own.

title: Purge the Disloyal
text: If successful, reduce your unrest by 1 and force another player to discard one supporting character of your race.

title: Raid Shipping
text: Babylon 5 loses 1 influence. Target one race toward whom you have a tension of at least 3. If successful, factions of the target race lose 1 influence. There is an additional Intrigue conflict. If you do not succeed at the Intrigue conflict, all players' tensions toward your race increase by 1.

title: Rally the People
text: Requires a Destiny Mark for you to initiate this conflict. Each player may only play this conflict once per game. Only characters of your race may participate in this conflict. For each 15 points by which this conflict succeeds, gain +1 influence.

title: Saber Rattling
text: Military may be used to support or oppose this conflict. Target a player. If successful, you gain +1 influence and the target increases his tension toward all players who supported the conflict by 1. If unsuccessful, the target gains +1 influence.

title: Sabotage
text: Target a fleet controlled by another player. The fleet's Military during resolution is applied as opposition to this conflict. If successful, the fleet takes damage equal to the amount by which you succeeded.

title: Shadow Assault
text: Requires three Shadow Marks to play. Target a location controlled by a player of another race. Shadows support the conflict with strength equal to Shadow influence. If successful, you may discard the location, or you may rotate one fleet to start a war against the location's owner and you capture the location.

title: Sleeper Personality
text: Initiates both an Intrigue and a Psi conflict targeting one Inner Circle character who is not an ambassador. If both conflicts are successful, the target is demoted to a supporting character. In addition, if you win the Psi conflict by 10 or more, the target becomes your supporting character until he is discarded.

title: Sponsor Rebels
text: Target one location. Apply the location's Military divided by 5 as opposition. If successful, the location is neutralized, and takes severe damage equal to the amount by which the conflict succeeds. The location heals as an Inner Circle character until unneutralized. If you fail, your ambassador gains 2 Doom Marks.

title: Stop Hostilities
text: Target two players at war. If this conflict succeeds, hold a Babylon 5 vote. If the vote passes, and if each player's influence is lower than Babylon 5's influence, the war ends. If the conflict succeeds by 10 or more, the players' tensions toward each other drop by 1.

title: Technological Espionage
text: Target one race. If successful, this card becomes a faction enhancement for you. This enhancement causes each of your races to inflict +1 damage when attacking or being attacked by fleets of the target race. You may have one Technological Espionage enhancement for each race. In addition, if you win by 10 or more, gain +1 influence.

title: Telepathic Scan
text: Target another player. If successful, the target player must show you a number of random cards from his hand equal to the base Psi score of the character you first rotated to support the conflict (up to his entire hand). Select and discard one of the cards.

title: Temptations
text: Target a supporting character. If you succeed by 5 or more, this conflict becomes a character enhancement on the target. The target's owner must apply the character's influence cost each turn during the draw round or discard him. Discard this card if the character is promoted to an Inner Circle character.

title: Terrorist Bombings
text: Any player may be supported in this conflict. The ambassadors belonging to the players with the two lowest generated totals take damage equal to the difference between their individual totals and the highest individual total. If there is a tie for second lowest total, all tied players' ambassadors also take damage.

title: Test Their Mettle
text: Target a faction of another race. Characters of your two races apply double Diplomacy during resolution. Your target may choose (at initiation to allow Military to support and oppose this conflict. If successful, gain +1 influence, and if you win by 5 or more your target loses 1 influence. If unsuccessful, exchange recipients of these effects.

title: Trade Pact
text: Target another race with whom you have a mutual tension of 3 or less and no Free Trade state. Characters of your two races apply double Diplomacy during resolution. If successful, there exists a state of Free Trade between your two races. While this is in effect, factions of your two races each have +1 influence rating.

title: Witness Protection
text: Target one supporting character in another player's discard pile. If you succeed by at least that character's influence cost, bring the target into play as a supporting character for you.

title: Babylon 5 Unrest
text: Babylon 5 loses 1 influence each turn during the draw round. Any player may initiate a Diplomacy conflict with 5 automatic opposition; if this conflict is successful, discard this enhancement.

title: Backroom Dealing
text: Target your ambassador. During a vote, you may alter one "abstain" vote cast by an ambassador besides the Vorlons (whether actively played or not) to a "yes" or "no". Apply any amount of influence when you do this. Any player may apply 1 more influence than you applied to return the vote to "abstain".

title: Concealed Weapon
text: May not be used with any other Weapon enhancement. Target character gains a Strife Mark.

title: Covert Allies
text: The target character gains a bonus to his Intrigue equal to half his Diplomacy (excluding any bonus from Power Posturing), rounded up. This bonus is recalculated each determine initiative step.

title: Isolated
text: Rotate your ambassador and select a target character. Call a Babylon 5 vote. If the vote passes, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence and the target character loses Intrigue equal to half of Babylon 5's influence, rounded up, to a minimum ability of 1.

title: Latent Telepath
text: A Non-Narn character with a Psi of 0 gains Psi 3. Cannot be played on an ambassador.

title: Luxuries of Homeworld
text: Target a supporting character. The target may act as an Inner Circle character until he is neutralized. Then, the character is not discarded and heals as an Inner Circle character, but once unneutralized, this enhancement must be discarded.

title: Overworked
text: Target an ambassador whose Ambassador's Assistant is not in play. The controller must apply 1 influence to ready his ambassador each round, or he does not ready. Discard this enhancement when the Ambassador's Assistant enters play.

title: Personal Protection
text: Target a character you control, and choose a character for him to protect. If ready and not neutralized, target character takes damage in place of the protected character when the protected character is attacked during a Diplomacy conflict.

title: Power Posturing
text: The target character gains a bonus to his Diplomacy equal to half his Intrigue (excluding any bonus from Covert Allies), rounded up. This bonus is recalculated each determine initiative step.

title: Prophecy
text: Must be sponsored by a seeress. Target character gains a Destiny Mark and a Doom Mark.

title: Psi Bodyguard
text: Target a character you control with Psi greater than 0. The target character may use half his Psi skill, rounded up, as if it were Intrigue to oppose an Intrigue conflict targeting any of your characters.

title: Pulling Strings
text: If target character does not have a Destiny Mark, discard this enhancement. As an action, the character's controller may rotate this enhancement and apply 2 influence to give the target character +2 Diplomacy for the rest of the turn.

title: Security Training
text: Target a character you control, and choose a character for him to protect. If ready and not neutralized, target character takes damage in place of the protected character when the protected character is attacked during an Intrigue conflict.

title: Shunned
text: Rotate your ambassador and select a target character. Call a Babylon 5 vote. If the vote passes, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence and the target character loses Diplomacy equal to half of Babylon 5's influence, rounded up, to a minimum ability of 1.

title: Vorlon Enhancement
text: Requires 4 Vorlon Marks to play. Target a character with Psi of 1 or more. The character's Psi is raised to 15.

title: Working Relationship
text: Target your ambassador, and choose a race other than your own. Your ambassador can sponsor characters of that race at -2 influence cost. You may play this card once for each race.

title: Assault Troops
text: For every influence the target player applies, he may apply +2 Military support to a Military conflict targeting a location.

title: Draft
text: If the target player is at war, his cost to sponsor fleets and any characters with Leadership of 2 or higher is reduced by 1.

title: Fixed in Their Ways
text: Requires 1 Vorlon Mark to play. Target yourself. Each turn in which you must discard a fleet due to a card which required Shadow Marks to bring into play, your ambassador gains 1 Vorlon Mark. Your ambassador gains 1 Vorlon Mark when you sponsor this enhancement.

title: Forced Commitment
text: Target yourself. Any war conflict initiated against you must be supported by at least two fleets or the initiator automatically loses the conflict. Apply 5 influence during the draw round, or discard this enhancement.

title: Isolationism
text: Target your faction. When players not of your race sponsor characters of your race, the cost for the character increases by an amount equal to your tension toward their race. Apply influence equal to your lowest tension during the draw round, or discard this enhancement.

title: Judgment by Success
text: Target one player. Whenever that player wins a conflict, reduce his unrest by 1. Whenever that player loses a conflict, increase his unrest by 1.

title: Mines
text: Faction Enhancement. If a war conflict is initiated against you, every fleet from any other race that participates in the conflict suffers 1 damage. Damage is inflicted when the fleet rotates, before it attacks, supports or opposes the conflict.

title: Secondary Control
text: Target yourself. You may sponsor groups of another race. To do so, the sponsoring character must be of the group's race, and you must apply double the group's influence cost.

title: Vital Interests
text: Target your faction. If you initiate a war conflict, and the conflict is successful, your target loses 1 influence. Apply 5 influence during the draw round, or discard this enhancement.

title: Censure
text: Rotate your ambassador and select a target fleet. Call a Babylon 5 vote. If the vote passes, Babylon 5 gains +1 influence and the target fleet loses Military equal to half of Babylon 5's influence, rounded up, to a minimum ability of 1.

title: Mass Drivers
text: The target fleet gains +10 Military while supporting a conflict targeting a location or while attacking a location. Each time this bonus is applied, all other players' tensions toward the controller of the fleet increase by 1, and Babylon 5 loses 1 influence.

title: Commerce Raiding
text: All Free Trade states are suspended (they are not in effect), and your faction has +1 influence rating while Commerce Raiding is in play. Any player may initiate a Military conflict with 10 automatic opposition. If this conflict is successful, discard this enhancement.

title: Armed Resistance
text: Target a location you played which was conquered. The unrest level of the current controller of the location increases by 1. You may initiate an extra Intrigue conflict each turn. If you win this conflict by 10 or more, you reconquer the location and this enhancement is discarded.

title: Exploitation
text: Target another race's location that you control. Treat the target location as if you had originally sponsored it (you gain all benefits of the location's effect text).

title: Fleet Support Base
text: Target one of your locations. Rotate this enhancement to repair up to 4 total points of damage from any combination of fleets you control.

title: Planetary Defenses
text: Target one of your locations. If you are the target of a Military conflict, you may rotate the target location to add half of its Military to a fleet that has already supported or opposed the conflict for the rest of the turn.

title: Salvage Yard
text: Target one of your locations. Whenever a fleet of your race is discarded, you may apply influence equal its cost to place it in its owner's hand instead of the discard pile, provided the Military rating printed on the card is less than 7.

title: Triluminary
text: Target the Minbari ambassador. The ambassador gains +2 Diplomacy while in possession of this item. Minbari tension toward the Humans cannot rise above 4 while this item is in play. Character gains a Destiny Mark and a Vorlon Mark.

title: Stealth Technology
text: Target fleet suffers only half damage (rounded up) during all attacks as long as your faction has no Doom Marks.

title: Energy Mines
text: All fleets attacking or being attacked by the target fleet suffer 1 point of damage before the attack is resolved.

title: A Good Bluff
text: All players may use Diplomacy to support or oppose a target Intrigue conflict.

title: Accident
text: Target one character or fleet. Target suffers 1 point of damage.

title: Armistice
text: Rotate your ambassador. If the mutual tensions of two races at war are each below 4, the war ends during the draw round.

title: Avert Incident
text: Tension levels toward your race cannot increase for the rest of the turn.

title: Balance
text: No player may apply more influence during the turn than the current influence rating of the least influential player.

title: Carpe Diem
text: Each player may only play Carpe Diem once per game. Select an event in your discard pile. Show that card to your opponents. Put that event in your hand.

title: Change of Plans
text: Target all of your characters who are currently participants in the one conflict. Apply 2 influence per targeted character. Ready the targeted characters. The support or opposition of those characters no longer applies to the conflict. They cannot participate in the same conflict again.

title: Changing Opinion
text: Target an opponent's character. That character cannot support or oppose conflicts for the rest of the turn.

title: Chaos Reigns
text: Requires 2 Shadow Marks to play. Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a new hand of cards, equal in size to the number of Shadow Marks you have. All other players with Shadow Marks may do the same.

title: Chrysalis
text: Requires 2 Vorlon Marks and the Triluminary. Rotate Delenn. Replace Delenn with Delenn Transformed from your hand, and transfer her aftermaths and enhancements. Your unrest increases by 2. Neutralize Delenn Transformed.

title: Competing Interests
text: Rotate all your characters with Vorlon Marks. You cannot play any other cards requiring Vorlon Marks this turn. All players must purge a number of Vorlon Marks equal to half the number of Vorlon Marks you have (rounded up).

title: Concentrated Effort
text: You may initiate a second conflict during next turn's conflict round. This second conflict must be from a conflict card.

title: Conflicting Desires
text: Rotate all your characters with Shadow Marks. You cannot play any other cards requiring Shadow Marks this turn. All players must purge a number of Shadow Marks equal to half the number of Shadow Marks you have (rounded up).

title: Conflicting Loyalties
text: Sponsor a limited character someone else has in play. Both copies of the character become rotated supporting characters. Whoever applies the most influence to promote the character on the next turn keeps the character, the other discards him (both discard if tied). You must apply at least the amount you would normally require to promote the character.

title: Confusion in Chaos
text: Requires 2 Shadow Marks to play. The action round ends. Apply any amount of influence when played. When played, any player may apply more influence than you applied to continue the round.

title: Contact with Shadows
text: The Shadows gain 1 influence. Target character you control gains a Shadow Mark.

title: Contact with Vorlons
text: The Vorlons gain 1 influence. Target character you control gains a Vorlon Mark.

title: Coordinated Fire
text: Rotate two of your fleets who can participate in the same conflict. Both fleets attack a participant fleet of your choice, but the attacked fleet only damages one of your two fleets (of his choice) in return.

title: Cut Supply Lines
text: All players may use Intrigue to support or oppose a target Military conflict.

title: Declaration of War
text: Requires a tension of 5 toward the target race. Rotate your ambassador. Your race and the target race are at war.

title: Defame Ambassador
text: All of the target ambassador's abilities are halved. This effect expires at the end of he turn.

title: Destiny Fulfilled
text: For the rest of the turn, all your ambassador's abilities increase by +1 for each Destiny Mark he has. For an additional 5 influence, all your other characters gain +1 to each of their abilities for Destiny Mark they have. For an additional 5 influence (11 total) this card becomes an enhancement for your ambassador (with the bonus fixed at play).

title: Diplomatic Blunder
text: Target ready character with Diplomacy greater than 1 has his Diplomacy lowered to 1. (Bonuses applied later this turn raise the ability from the new base of 1.) This effect expires at the end of the turn.

title: Diplomatic Immunity
text: Target player's ambassador and ambassador's assistant cannot be attacked this turn.

title: Early Warning
text: Rotate a character with 2 or more Vorlon Marks. Apply the Vorlon's influence as opposition to a target Intrigue conflict. The Vorlons then gain +1 influence.

title: Emergency Military Aid
text: For every 2 influence you apply when playing this card, apply 1 Military to support or oppose target conflict.

title: Fleets on the Border
text: All players may use Military to support or oppose a target Diplomacy conflict.

title: For My People
text: Rotate and neutralize your ambassador. Your ambassador gains a Destiny Mark.

title: For the Common Good
text: Rotate your ambassador and lose 1 influence. Babylon 5 gains 2 influence.

title: For the Good of All
text: For each of your characters or fleets that is neutralized this turn, and for each Destiny Mark you have, you gain +2 influence to use on the next turn only. This influence does not count toward power.

title: Forces Collide
text: Requires 3 Shadow Marks to play. Target one enhancement. Apply influence equal to the cost of the enhancement, plus 1 per Vorlon Mark required to play the card. Discard the enhancement.

title: Hidden Knowledge
text: Requires 2 Vorlon Marks to play. Apply up to 5 influence per player. You may look at a number of cards from the top of each player's deck equal to the amount of influence you applied for that player. Replace the cards in any order you desire.

title: Hire Raiders
text: Rotate one of your characters with Intrigue. For each influence you apply, up to a maximum of the character's Intrigue, do 1 point of damage to a target fleet. Your character gains a Doom Mark.

title: Hour of the Wolf
text: Ready an Inner Circle character who has rotated. The effect of his action is not canceled. If the character participated in a conflict, he cannot participate in that same conflict.

title: Internal Strife
text: Target player's unrest increases by 1.

title: Intrigues Mature
text: All players may use Intrigue to support or oppose a target Diplomacy conflict.

title: Knowledge of Shadows
text: Requires 1 Shadow Mark to play. Go through your deck and select 1 event card of your choice which directly modifies Military or Leadership. Show it to your opponent, then put it in your hand. Shuffle your deck.

title: Knowledge of the Soul
text: Rotate a Soul Hunter you control. Target a character in another player's discard pile who is not currently in play. The character becomes your supporting character for the rest of the turn, and is then discarded (to the same discard pile).

title: Lack of Subtlety
text: Target ready character with Intrigue greater than 1 has his Intrigue lowered to 1. (Bonuses applied later this turn raise the ability from the new base of 1.) This effect expires at the end of the turn.

title: Liquidating Assets
text: If all other players agree, you gain +5 influence to apply during the current turn (only). If you gain this influence, all other players permanently gain +1 influence during the resolution round.

title: Lockdown
text: All Intrigue conflicts have +5 Intrigue added to their opposition total. You must apply 5 influence per Intrigue conflict in play.

title: Long Term Investment
text: Lose 1 influence. Gain +1 power.

title: Medical Assistance
text: Target a neutralized supporting character. Treat him as an Inner Circle character until he is unneutralized.

title: Meditation
text: Draw 2 cards.

title: Merchandising B5
text: Babylon 5 cannot lose any more influence this turn. The next card you play is reduced in cost by 2 influence (to a minimum of 0).

title: Moral Quandary
text: Target a character. The target character is rotated for no effect. The owner of the character may negate this event by applying influence equal to the character's cost.

title: News of Galactic Import
text: No conflicts may be played next turn. News of Galactic Import cannot be played next turn.

title: Not Meant to Be
text: Reverse the printed effect text of an event played since your last chance to act. You must apply influence equal to that applied by the event's player, plus 2 influence per mark required to play the event.

title: Political Realignment
text: Increase or decrease one race's unrest by 1.

title: Prolonged Talks
text: Target Diplomacy conflict in play does not resolve this turn. Instead, the totals applied during resolution are noted, and it is reinitiated next turn with the prior totals already applied. The initiator of the conflict may initiate an additional conflict next turn. (Participants of the original conflict are not participants of the new conflict.)

title: Rally to the Cause
text: Apply any amount of influence. Remove that amount of severe damage tokens from cards you control.

title: Ramming
text: Target one of your fleets that was attacked and neutralized. Purge a Destiny Mark. The fleet that attacked your fleet takes damage equal to your neutralized fleet's printed Military.

title: Recalled to Service
text: Select a character in your discard pile. Show that card to your opponents. Put that character in your hand.

title: Sanctions
text: All players may use Diplomacy to support or oppose a target Military conflict.

title: Secret Strike
text: If you did not initiate a conflict this turn, rotate a character with Intrigue to do so immediately.

title: Secret Vorlon Aid
text: Rotate a character with 2 Vorlon Marks. Apply +5 Intrigue to support or oppose an Intrigue conflict.

title: Seduction
text: Target a character. Character's Intrigue is reduced for the rest of the turn by 1 per influence you apply (to a minimum of 1).

title: Self Doubt
text: Target a supporting character. Rotate the character for no effect.

title: Shadow Strike
text: Requires 2 Shadow Marks to play. Target a fleet. Apply an amount of influence equal to the target fleet's current Military. If target fleet's current Military is not greater than current Shadow influence, neutralize it.

title: Short Term Goals
text: Purge a Destiny Mark. Gain +1 influence.

title: Short Term Investment
text: Apply any amount of influence. For each 3 influence you apply, you gain +1 influence for the next turn only. This additional influence does not count toward power.

title: Sneak Attack
text: Play at the same time you rotate one of your fleets to support a conflict. Apply influence equal to the cost of another player's fleet. Rotate that fleet for no effect.

title: Sortie
text: Target any location. The target location may rotate to apply opposition equal to 1/5 of its Military rating to one Military conflict of your choice which targets a card in the location's faction, or its faction as a whole.

title: Special Ops
text: All players may use Military to support or oppose a target Intrigue conflict.

title: Strafing Run
text: All of your fleets do +1 damage this turn when they attack.

title: Strategic Reassignment
text: Target one of your characters leading a fleet. He is no longer leading the fleet, but he remains rotated.

title: Subliminal Influence
text: You may move each of your tension ratings and your unrest level up or down 1.

title: Support Babylon 5
text: Rotate your ambassador. Hold a Babylon 5 vote. Babylon 5 gains +1 influence for each yes vote. If the vote passes, Babylon 5 gains +1 additional influence.

title: The Opposition Rises
text: Target a player. The cost for that player to sponsor any card or play events increases by an amount equal to his unrest for the rest of the turn.

title: The Price of Power
text: Target a player. He must discard a character he controls or he does not gain any influence from conflicts this turn.

title: Trade Windfall
text: Gain +1 influence if you are in a state of Free Trade with another race.

title: Universe Today Feature
text: Increase or decrease one other race's tension toward one any race by 1.

title: Unrecognized Data
text: Target a fleet. The target fleet cannot be attacked for the rest of the turn.

title: Victory in My Grasp
text: Rotate your ambassador. Increase all your fleets' Military ratings by +1 for each Destiny Mark your ambassador has for the rest of the turn.

title: Vorlon Rescue
text: Requires 2 or more Vorlon Marks on the target neutralized participant Inner Circle character. The character becomes rotated (if ready), unneutralized with no damage. Discard any enhancement or aftermath targeting this character which can cause damage to this character.

title: War by Popular Decree
text: Target a player who has 3 or more unrest and choose a race toward whom the player's race has a tension of 5. The player's race declares war against the chosen race.

title: What Do You Want?
text: Any player who wishes rotates his ambassador. Each ambassador who rotates gains a Shadow Mark. The Shadows gain +1 influence for each mark taken.

title: Who Are You?
text: Any player who wishes rotates his ambassador. Each ambassador who rotates gains a Vorlon Mark. The Vorlons gain +1 influence for each mark taken.

title: You Are Not Ready
text: Requires 3 Vorlon Marks to play. Discard 1 conflict in play. It does not resolve. The Vorlons gain 2 influence.

title: You Know My Reputation
text: For the rest of the turn, your ambassador gains Diplomacy equal to his Destiny Marks, Shadow Marks and Vorlon Marks, plus 1 per fleet you rotate when playing this card.

title: Approval of the Grey
text: Target one of your supporting characters who is a Grey Council Member. Promote that character to the Inner Circle.

title: Battle Tested
text: Target a character who led a participating fleet. Increase the target's Leadership by 1. If the target's fleet supported a Lost Conflict or opposed a Won Conflict, the total damage he can sustain drops by 2.

title: Blood Oath
text: Target a participant character, and choose a player whose character opposed the conflict. The target participant character gains a Strife Mark when attacking characters controlled by that player.

title: Casualty Reports
text: Each player with a participant supporting character who led a fleet in the conflict must discard one of those characters. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Combat Experience
text: Participant character gains +1 Leadership.

title: Crisis of Self
text: Cannot target an ambassador. Rotate target participant character if he is ready. Owner must apply twice the character's influence cost to ready him. Discard this aftermath when this cost is applied.

title: Despair
text: Target a player with a Doom Mark. Whenever the player loses a conflict, all of his characters have -1 to each ability on the following turn (minimum 0).

title: Develop Relationship
text: Target another player's supporting character, after that character supports one of your conflicts. That character gains +1 to all his abilities, but if he ever attacks your characters or opposes one of your conflicts, discard him.

title: Diplomatic Advantage
text: Play on your ambassador. You must have won the conflict by 10 or more strength. You may draw 2 free cards instead of 1 during the draw round.

title: Disenchantment
text: Demote target participant Inner Circle character, other than an ambassador, to a supporting character. The target character does not ready during the next ready round. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Disgrace
text: Target a participating supporting character. Fleets led by the character may not support or attack during conflicts initiated by his controller.

title: Enrage
text: Target ambassador must apply 1 influence each turn at the beginning of the action round, or his Diplomacy ability for the turn is 0.

title: Exploit Opportunities
text: Target ambassador gains +1 Intrigue and +1 Diplomacy.

title: Focus Your Efforts
text: Target one of your participant characters. Reduce one of his abilities (of 2 or more) by 2, and raise another of his abilities by 2.

title: Glory
text: Target ambassador gains a Destiny Mark.

title: Grievance
text: Target the winner of the conflict. Hold a Babylon 5 vote. If the vote passes, target loses 1 influence, while you and Babylon 5 gain 1 influence. If the vote fails, you lose 1 influence. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Guilt
text: Target a character who led a fleet that made an attack during the conflict. Any fleets the character leads may not attack.

title: Harvest Souls
text: Rotate a Soul Hunter you control. Your ambassador gains all the Destiny Marks from all supporting characters neutralized in the conflict. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Hidden Agent
text: Target your ambassador. Select another faction that participated in the conflict. Discard any Hidden Agent that faction has affecting your faction. The selected player must choose and show you his face-down conflict card before you choose conflict each turn.

title: Hunted
text: Target a participant character. Two influence must be applied each time the character is readied, or he remains rotated.

title: In the Line of Duty
text: Play when a limited supporting character was neutralized during an attack. Remove the character from play. (No copy of the character can reenter play.) (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Inevitable Destiny
text: Target a conflict that was just resolved. Go through your deck until you find the first aftermath playable on that conflict, then play it. Shuffle your deck. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Intolerable Interference
text: Play after a conflict you initiated. Target one player who opposed your conflict, or attacked one of your characters, but who was not a target of the conflict. Increase your tension toward that player by 2. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: It Will Be His Undoing
text: Target player loses 1 influence for each Doom Mark he has. Purge all his Doom Marks. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Lamentations
text: Target ambassador cannot participate in any conflict. Discard this aftermath at the beginning of the next aftermath round.

title: Learning Experience
text: Participant character gains +1 Intrigue.

title: Left Vulnerable
text: Each turn, all players may apply influence to lower one of the target ambassador's abilities. For every 3 influence a player applies, one ability of his choice is reduced by 1 until the end of the turn (minimum 0).

title: Loss of Face
text: If the final strength supporting the conflict was 0, the initiator of the conflict loses 1 influence. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Martyr
text: Play on yourself. Discard one of your Inner Circle characters. Convert all of your Doom Marks into Destiny Marks. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Negotiated Surrender
text: Target both parties in a war conflict. Reduce both parties' tension toward each other to 4 and end the war. The loser of the conflict loses 2 influence, the winner gains 2 influence. If either participant has more influence than Babylon 5, he may negate this card. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: News of Defeat
text: Target a player who lost a fleet in the conflict. His ambassador loses 1 point from an ability of your choice.

title: Nightmares
text: Target participant character gains a Doom Mark.

title: No Escape
text: Discard one participant fleet that received at least half its printed military ability in damage during the turn. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Older but Wiser
text: Participant character gains +1 Diplomacy.

title: Paying for Sins
text: Target a participant Inner Circle character, besides the ambassador, who has a Doom Mark. Discard the target character. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Personal Enemies
text: Target the ambassador. The ambassador's controller must apply 1 influence to rotate his ambassador during his action.

title: Personal Involvement
text: Discard a neutralized participant Inner Circle character. Cannot target an ambassador. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Personal Sacrifice
text: Target your participant ambassador. The amount of damage required to neutralize your ambassador drops by 2. However, apply +2 Diplomacy when your ambassador supports a conflict (this is not an ability increase).

title: Protests
text: Target ambassador's race must have unrest of 4 or 5. Target ambassador's highest ability drops to 0. Discard this card if the race's unrest drops below 4.

title: Public Apology
text: If the initiator of the conflict neutralized another player's fleet in an attack, his ambassador's printed Diplomacy is reduced by 2, he loses 1 influence and his unrest grows by 1. The player whose fleet was attacked gains 1 influence. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Racial Hatred
text: Target player must have an unrest of 4 or more. Player must discard all characters he has in play who are not loyal to his ambassador's race, and may not sponsor any more.

title: Refugees
text: Play after a war conflict. Target player loses 1 influence, and Babylon 5 gains 1 influence. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Renowned Victory
text: The initiator must have won the conflict by at least 5 strength and must have neutralized at least 5 Military strength of fleets with attacks. Target ambassador gains +1 Diplomacy, +2 Leadership and a Destiny Mark.

title: Repairing the Past
text: Discard one aftermath that targets a card in your faction, or that targets your faction as a whole. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Rescue
text: The leader of a neutralized participant fleet is returned to an undamaged, but still rotated, condition. He gains a Doom Mark. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Retribution
text: Target participant character takes 1 damage for each Inner Circle character you control who is not neutralized. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Reverse Advances
text: Discard one aftermath that targets a card in another player's faction, or that targets his faction as a whole. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Rise to Power
text: Rotate your ambassador and one other character you control with at least 3 Intrigue. Purge up to two Destiny Marks from your ambassador. Gain 1 influence for each mark purged. Ambassador gains a Doom Mark.

title: Rivalry
text: Choose two non-ambassador Inner Circle characters you control, at least one of whom must be a participant character. The target must demote one of the two characters to a supporting character. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Secondary Experience
text: Target a participant character whose ability used in the conflict is not his highest ability. Character gains +2 in the ability used in the conflict.

title: Skeletons in the Closet
text: Target a participant character. All of the character's abilities drop by 1 per Doom Mark he has, to a minimum of 1. Purge all his Doom Marks.

title: Successful Manipulation
text: Target ambassador gains +2 Intrigue.

title: Under Pressure
text: Target participant character loses 3 Intrigue (to a minimum of 1). Discard this aftermath when his faction wins an Intrigue conflict.

title: United Front
text: Your ambassador gains +3 Diplomacy while supporting conflicts you initiate.

title: Vendetta
text: Target one of your characters. Play only after another player has neutralized one of your supporting characters in an attack. Your target character gains a Strife Mark whenever attacking the neutralized character's attacker.

title: War Hero
text: Target an ambassador after his faction captures a location. The ambassador gains +2 Diplomacy and +2 Leadership.

title: Wear and Tear
text: Inflict 1 point of damage on every fleet that participated in the conflict. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Wounded
text: Target participant character is neutralized, and takes 1 point of severe damage for each Doom Mark he has. (Discard this aftermath after play.)

title: Commercial Telepaths
text: Rotate this group and target a character who is not targeted by Commercial Telepaths. That character gains a bonus to his Diplomacy equal to half his Psi, rounded up, while this group remains rotated. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's, and no full stop is legible at the end of the first line.)

title: Counterintelligence
text: Rotate and target an Intrigue conflict Your characters participating in that conflict take half damage, rounded up, when attacked. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's, and no full stop is legible at the end of the first line.)

title: Damage Control Team
text: Rotate and target one of your fleets. The fleet takes half damage, rounded up, when attacked for the rest of the turn. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Diplomatic Corps
text: Rotate and target a character. That character gains +2 Diplomacy while this group remains rotated. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Extended Contacts
text: Rotate and target a character. That character gains +2 Intrigue while this group remains rotated. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Government Opposition
text: Choose a race for this group to affect when it is first played. Rotate and apply influence equal to the cost of a target group of that race. Treat that group as if it had no effect text for the rest of the turn. (The card prints the rules in three lines in the box under the art; the line breaks are the card's.)

title: Interstellar Corporation
text: Any other voting player may apply influence for you on your turn, with your permission. That player may require you to apply the same amount of influence for him during any of his actions on a future turn.

title: ISN
text: Media. Rotate this group to reverse a tension change which occurred since your last action.

title: Military Cadre
text: Rotate and target a character. That character gains +2 Leadership while this group remains rotated.

title: Military Telepaths
text: Rotate this group and target a character who is not targeted by Military Telepaths. That character gains a bonus to his Military equal to half his Psi, rounded up, while this group remains rotated.

title: Motivated Leaders
text: While you are the target of a war conflict, all of your characters gain +1 Leadership.

title: Observers
text: Target another willing player when you play this group. Each aftermath played on the target faction must be approved or discarded by you. Any player may apply 5 influence when playing an aftermath to negate this effect for that aftermath.

title: Rabble Rousers
text: Target a race when you play this card. Rotate this group to allow a character of your race to do extra damage in an attack against a member of the target race. The extra damage is equal to your race's tension toward the target race.

title: Ranger Strike Team
text: Ranger Group. While you control this group, you may rotate any of your fleets to increase Babylon 5's influence for the rest of the turn by +1 per 5 Military of the fleet. This bonus cannot contribute to raising Babylon 5's influence above 19 unless the Shadow War has begun. Printed qualifier: "Ranger Group." (printed as a bold line at the head of the rules text). [Verified 2026-10-25 by opencode-glm-5-3-flash-free-02 against the scan: the bold line "Ranger Group." prints at the head of the rules text and was originally omitted from this transcription; it is now recorded. The rest of the transcription is confirmed correct.]

title: Rangers Surveillance
text: Ranger Group. Requires 1 Vorlon Mark to sponsor. While this group is in play, you gain +10 influence for initiative determination only.

title: Secret Police
text: Rotate this group and target a character who is not targeted by Secret Police. That character gains a bonus to his Intrigue equal to half his Psi, rounded up, while this group remains rotated. (The card prints the rules in four lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Spin Doctors
text: Rotate and target a Diplomacy conflict. Your characters participating in that conflict take half damage, rounded up, when attacked. (The card prints the rules in four lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: War College
text: Your cost to sponsor any character with Leadership greater than 0 is reduced by 2. (The card prints the rules in three lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Imperial Telepaths
text: Rotate to draw the top 2 cards from your deck. Then, place 3 cards from your hand at the bottom of your deck.

title: Influential Lords
text: If a conflict can increase Centauri influence, rotate this group to apply +5 Diplomacy or +3 Intrigue in support of the conflict.

title: Religious Caste
text: Increase your unrest by 1 when sponsored. All your worker and warrior caste Minbari are -1 to each ability. All your religious caste Minbari gain +1 Diplomacy and +1 Leadership.

title: Warrior Caste
text: Increase your unrest by 1 when sponsored. All your religious and worker caste Minbari are -1 to each ability. All your warrior caste Minbari gain +1 Intrigue and +1 Leadership. (The card prints the rules in five lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Wind Swords
text: Increase Minbari unrest by 1 when sponsored. The cost for you to sponsor any Minbari fleet or Minbari character with Leadership is reduced by 2. (The card prints the rules in five lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Narn Rabble
text: Rotate and target a character whose highest ability is 4 or less. That character rotates for no effect.

title: Thenta Makur
text: All Narn in play gain a Strife Mark while Thenta Makur is in play. (The card prints the rules in two lines in the box under the art; the line break is the card's.)

title: Immolan V
text: > Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. > Rotate this location while your ambassador is supporting a conflict to give him +3 Intrigue for the rest of the turn.

title: Ragesh III
text: Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. Rotate Ragesh III as an action to add a construction token to this card. Each time you sponsor a card, remove all construction tokens from Ragesh III. Each token removed reduces the cost for you to sponsor that card by 1 (to a minimum cost of 0).

title: Proxima III
text: > Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. > Your cost to promote any character to your Inner Circle is reduced by 2 (to a minimum cost of 0).

title: Transfer Point Io
text: Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. Rotate with a character when you sponsor a card besides a character. Reduce the cost of that card by the number of Trade Pacts in play.

title: Minbari Protectorate
text: > Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. While this location is in play, reduce your cost to sponsor neutral characters and characters from any race whose ambassador is not in play by 2.

title: Quadrant 14
text: > Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. > Rotate Quadrant 14 as an action to add a construction token to this card. Each time you sponsor a fleet, remove all construction tokens from Quadrant 14. Each token removed reduces the cost for you to sponsor that fleet by 2 (to a minimum cost of 0).

title: Quadrant 37
text: > Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. > Rotate and apply 10 influence. Search your deck from the top and find the first Narn fleet that could be sponsored (limited and not in play or multiple). Put it into play. Shuffle your deck. If the fleet is not neutralized by the end of the turn, place it back in your deck and reshuffle.

title: Sleeping Z'ha'dum
text: Location's Military may only be used to oppose conflicts targeting this location. Your ambassador gains a Doom Mark. Any player may rotate Sleeping Z'ha'dum to cause the Shadows to gain +1 influence whenever a card is played which provides or requires Shadow Marks.

title: John Sheridan
text: John Sheridan may replace Jeffrey Sinclair. Whenever John Sheridan gains a mark of a type he does not have, he gains an additional mark of that type. Rotate John Sheridan as an action and play a conflict card. You must apply 3 influence (in addition to any other requirements) for each prior action you have had this turn to initiate this additional conflict.
